build_dictionary_from_corpus: build a vocabulary dictionary from source and target language corpus files with frequency thresholds
binarize_text_data: binarize raw text files into indexed dataset format using a prebuilt dictionary for fairseq training
create_joined_dictionary: create a joined dictionary from both source and target language training data for shared vocabularies
process_parallel_workers: process and binarize large datasets in parallel using multiple worker processes for faster preprocessing
generate_alignment_dictionary: generate a word alignment dictionary from alignment files mapping source to target token indices
